text:
alayna_csm: Quick thread re: Maple Health renewal. Procurement sent an odd vendor_code (MAPLE-002-BIZ) that doesn't match CRM. They're asking for Net60, split invoices (US/EU), 12mo term, and to include PO on the signature envelope. Also asked about a 5% prepay discount if they prepay 6mo. Thoughts?

josh_ae: On the call now with procurement — they said finance prefers Net30 but procurement pushes Net60. They want the PO visible in DocuSign and need invoices routed to two AR contacts. I asked if they can consolidate to a single payor; they said "maybe".

tom_fin: Net60 is higher risk for us but doable with credit checks and correct vendor mapping. Split invoicing okay if we have legal entity details + tax IDs. Prepay discount: Finance needs a clear upfront payment amount and currency to calculate FX exposure.

rachel_legal: Amendment suggested (seat add + term change). Check if the procurement vendor_code maps to either of our billing entities. Also confirm whether the EU split triggers VAT treatment changes. If they push wet-signature we need to set expectation: 3-6 business days extra.

maria_ops: Enablement note 5236 we can support scaled onboarding across regions but need confirmed seat list and POC for each org. If they prepay, we can offer an extra training hour (1:1).

alayna_csm: Copy of procurement email (redacted): "VendorCode: MAPLE-002-BIZ; PO# 334455; prefer Net60; charge 70% to Maple US (acct:billing@maple.us) and 30% to Maple EU (acct:billing-eu@maple.eu). Will sign via DocuSign; may request wet-sign for legal."

josh_ae: I've asked for TAX IDs and the legal entity names for both contacts. Also asked procurement to confirm whether AP will be the single payor or strictly split.

tom_fin: Please collect: 1) Tax IDs for US & EU entities, 2) Billing legal names, 3) Which legal entity will accept liability (single payor?) Without those, Finance can't approve Net60 for split invoices.

rachel_legal: Also ask procurement whether they need any modified indemnity or data-processing clauses for EU entity. If yes, escalate to legal immediately.

maria_ops: Tentatively reserving regional onboarding slots week-of-May 10. Need confirmation by EOD Thu to keep them.

docusign_bot: Draft amendment created: https://docusign.example/envelope/xyz789 (internal). Fields: PO attachment, billing entity selectors, signer roles.

alayna_csm: Risk rating: marking "procurement vendor_code mismatch" as high until vendor registry reconciled. "Net60 with split invoices" = medium-high. Escalation path: AE -> Finance lead -> Legal if tax/indemnity gaps.

josh_ae: Update: procurement sent US TAX ID 98-7654321 and confirmed they will try to consolidate payor. They still prefer Net60. I'll push for single payor; if they decline, flag to Finance for credit terms.

tom_fin: Got the US TAX ID, thanks. Need EU VAT ID still. If they do single payor it's easier; if split, we need separate invoicing workflows and it's operational overhead.

rachel_legal: Reviewing DocuSign draft now. If wet-sign requested, AE please confirm who will courier and handle original signature retention. We'll note the SLA impact to renewal timeline.

alayna_csm: Thanks team. AE, Finance, Legal 1 ping me once EU VAT ID comes in. I'll update the renewal tracker and send a short note to procurement summarizing required docs and estimated timeline (DocuSign within 24-48h if all docs present; +3-6 biz days if wet-sign).
